lede: SMART's board meets Wednesday to approve a lease with Telluride Gymnastics Academy at 137 Society Drive, marking one of the few concrete decisions on this week's government calendar. Most other meetings across the valley — from Planning Commission to Town Council — haven't posted agendas yet. Community-wise, it's a busy stretch with the Historical Museum opening their new San Miguel Stories exhibit, the Rico Trails Alliance throwing a membership fiesta, and the usual lineup of library programs and farmers market.
